title: Legends of Snooker: One Shot
description:
Plays That Appear to Be ImpossibleFind the Perfect Angle

Legend of snooker will leave you instigated to give the 8 ball its endFeaturing:• Classic snooker look but will challenge you.

• The game has 100 different levels.

• The more you evolve, the game will become more difficult.

• If you don't get it right away, you can look the last move marker.

• Original Composed Soundtracks.

• You only have one shot to hit the 8 ball, and you cannot hit the other balls in the hole.
description_short: Legends of Snooker: One Shot, is a game that will bring out the best of your snooker skills. The puzzle will challenge you with several possible moves that vary according to your progress in the game.
